print(f"1980 redemption rate: {redemptions_1980} / {avg_outstanding_1980} = {rate_1980:.6f} = {rate_1980*100:.2f}%")

# Relative difference in percentage points
diff = (rate_1980 - rate_1981) * 100
print(f"\nRelative difference: {rate_1980*100:.2f} - {rate_1981*100:.2f} = {diff:.2f} percentage points")
